Definition: Gibah; the name of three places in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Gibeah = "hill"; 1) a city in the mountain district of Judah; 2) a city of Benjamin, birthplace of king Saul; 3) a city in Kirjath-jearim of Ephraim
